^Nate: Yeah, me and Hilbert were there as well.
^Liora: What does this mean... Rose... lied?
^Liora: Myrtle? What are you doing here?
^Myrtle: Everyone is inside Biz's right now. They will be coming out in a second.
^Myrtle: I wouldn't be seen associating with them Liora...
ask_about_riley: ^Liora: You're Riley, right? Are you also an orphan.
^Riley: Yep! BUT not just that, I am the HOLY KNIGHT of Legend!
^Riley: You haven't heard the myths? The Knight will come and save everyone with the Legendary Sword! I will become that Knight and save everyone!
^Nate: *sigh* Just ignore everything this guy says. He is a younger kid in the orphanage and is obessed with Knights.
^Liora: Oh, I see. I know that there have been knights in the distant past who used to travel with party members of different races and abilities.
^Nate: Yeah, it's from those stories that he became obsessed.
^Liora: But nowadays, knights are extinct- or at least extremely rare.
^Nate: You can probably ask him about the gem now, even if he is enthusiastic he listens to people.
defend_orphans: ^Liora: These orphans are not "feral"! They're normal kids just like us.
^Rose: You're going to betray us, after everything we did and went through?
^Liora: Rose. You lied to me. You lied and just want the gem for yourself.
^Liora: I can't have them hating on you for no reason.
^Rose: You idiot. Just wait until I get back from the Magic Academia.
^Natalie: ... I hope you know what you're doing girl.
^Henry: *sigh* I trust your decision but I have to go now. Good luck Liora.
^Hilbert: We still can't trust her- she's a witch!
^Riley: I say she embarks on a JOURNEY to prove her INNOCENCE!
^Nate: ... What he said. He's the one who found the gem anyways.
^Riley: If you can defeat the Lunar Fenrir and collect its items then you have proven your loyalty to the Werewolf Gang!
go_to_friends_side: ^Rose: Oh, Liora! Fancy seeing you here. What are you doing?
^Liora: I was trying to get the gem back from these three.
^Rose: I didn't see the trash standing there- let's just grab it and go. It doesn't belong to dirty and feral monsters.
^Nate: ... Hah, I expected this to happen. Just take it and leave us.
^Henry: Please leave the area. This is by my parents restaurant.
^Rose: Ugh, it has their dirt on it! Let's clean it off and then it's all yours Liora!
^Myrtle: You did the right thing Liora.
defeated_lunar_fenrir: ^Nate: Hey! Hope you are alright. I heard the Lunar Fenrir can be a tough opponent.
^Riley: Wait you're actually super strong! AMAZING!
^Hilbert: Operation: Funny Three-Man Adult is a go!
^Nate: Really, thank you for making their day. I appreciate that you went through the trouble.
^Riley: Here is the gemstone, honorary member of the Werewolf Gang!
enter_capital: ^Liora: Huh? What's that voice? It's leading me to the arena?
enter_arena: ^Liora: Huh? Who are you? Wait, those robes. You're the current Court Magician Circe?!
^Liora: Why are you reaching out to me like this? I'm not even a member of The Royal Guard yet!
^Circe: I wanted to applaud you for taking my seal off of the gate.
^Liora: Your seal? You sealed the gate?
^Circe: I wanted to seal off those animals that inhabit Mystveil. For you see- I was the one who turned them into the monsterous forms they have now.
^Liora: Wait, the monsters in the forest? You did that to them? They were originally people?
^Circe: And now that it is broken, they can flood back in to hurt the people of this beloved capital.
^Liora: They are already hurting the people in Mystveil though!
^Circe: One town out of many is a small casualty.
^Circe: On the other hand, you have weathered many difficulties to make it here. Tell you what, I can help you with your enrollment and make you my successor.
^Circe: With my power, it will be easy. You can become The Court Magician you've always wanted to be.
^Circe: All you have to do is follow my every word.

b: ^Circe: Even if I leave, there is the entire Royal Guard and the Royal family who will appoint the next successor. You will never be chosen!
^Liora: Even if I'm not chosen, I'll rise the ranks towards becoming The Court Magician. Just watch!
^Circe: ... Your passion mirrors mine from when I first joined. Where did all of that courage, empathy, and justice go? Perhaps you were always meant to best me in a duel.
^Circe: Urgh... You haven't defeated me yet. I can sense your cowardice. You cannot withstand this spell-!
^Circe: My magic will make you forget this encounter. Now go and join The Royal Guard... and become my subordinate.
